title: Hippogriff
summary: HIP'POGRIFF, noun [Gr. a horse, and a griffon.] A fabulous animal or monster, half horse and half griffon; a winged horse, imagined by Ariosto.

inlines.v: HIP'POGRIFF, noun [Gr. a horse, and a griffon.] A fabulous animal or monster, half horse and half griffon; a winged horse, imagined by Ariosto.
